title: Transposon insertion / essentiality
description: All 4313 gene rows in the published initial-library essentiality table, with the matching LB-outgrowth insertion index where available.
reference: K-12 BW25113; no genome-coordinate alignment applied
unit: distinct insertion sites per gene base pair
processing: Read the published S1 and S4 workbooks, join unambiguous exact gene names; repeated initial-library names retain source-row identifiers and ambiguous outgrowth matches are omitted. Preserve insertion index, log-likelihood ratio, and published essential/non-essential/unclear categories. No essentiality prediction or coordinate inference is performed.
limits: Gene-level summary, not individual insertion sites or read counts.
No genomic coordinates are supplied by these summary tables.
Published putative essentiality includes genes with a severe fitness cost; it is condition dependent.
